_readme: DE-04 Api Contracts Agent config. Generates OpenAPI specs and a schema registry from structured requirements and the data design output produced by DE-03.

agent.name: Api Contracts Agent
agent.description: Generates OpenAPI endpoint specifications and registers schema contracts from business specifications and data design model via shared folder, producing a validated contract layer for downstream service implementation.

behaviour._methods_note: GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE are standard HTTP verbs for crud_endpoint/query_endpoint/integration_endpoint. CONSUME/PUBLISH/SUBSCRIBE are event-driven verbs used for event_endpoint contracts (e.g., Kafka topics).
behaviour._blocking_note: recommendation=blocked is returned to GenWiz as blocking — should be resolved before downstream design agents run

structured_requirements.description: Array of REQ-### items extracted from business specification documents

data_model.description: Array of DM-### entity definitions from data design (DE-03) output. If missing, agent will check for data_design_model_and_strategy field.

project_context.description: Project context extracted from business docs

agent_interaction_diagram.description: Agent interaction diagram (Business_Process_Agent_Interaction.html or .md) showing workflow between agents

agent_network_diagram.description: Agent network diagram (Business_Process_Agent_Network.html or .md) showing agent topology

agent_architecture.description: Agent architecture JSON from BRD response containing agent specifications

openapi_spec.description: One item per API endpoint contract derived from structured requirements and data design entities.

schema_registry.description: Aggregated registry of all validated schemas and contract coverage across all endpoints.

openapi_builder.description: Builds OpenAPI specification documents from structured requirements and data design entities, grouping endpoints by domain resource and HTTP method.

schema_validator.description: Validates all endpoint schemas against contract rules and flags inconsistencies, missing req_id_refs, duplicate paths, or disallowed HTTP methods.

contract_store.description: Compiles and indexes validated API contracts into the schema registry, computing coverage counts and setting the recommendation value.

contract_classifier.description: Classifies each generated endpoint by contract_category using the contract_categories list from behaviour.

git_reader._enabled_note: false → read from local files under tech_stack.git_reader.local_audit_dir. true → read from the real audit repo via GitPython. Toggle per environment.
git_reader._note: run_id is passed by GenWiz as X-Run-ID header on every agent call. Agent uses it to resolve the path and read previous step output.

supported_formats._output_note: Agent always writes both JSON and DOCX files. JSON is returned via HTTP. DOCX provides human-readable Word document with formatted tables.

freeform_extraction._note: Free-form documents (docx/pdf/html) are parsed for text and then an LLM call extracts structured fields. No fixed template required.

input_sources.description: Agent interaction diagram (searches in thread root)
Agent network diagram (searches in thread root)

shared_io._note: API Contracts reads from: 1) bs_docs (requirements), 2) thread root (agent diagrams by name), 3) brd_response (architecture JSON)
